blocks.text: Written by: Patrick de Veyra In an increasingly digitized economy, connectivity brings immense opportunity—but it also exposes the country’s most vulnerable populations to new and evolving risks. For Globe Telecom, addressing this challenge isn’t just a technical mandate handled by security protocols; it has become a personal mission driven directly by its workforce. For 917 GDay 2026, Globe brought its employees together in a celebration centered on connection, appreciation, and giving back. Through Globe of Good, more than 800 employee volunteers shared their time and skills with communities, with employees’ collective pledges amounting to over P2 million to support the initiative.
